type.description: Relewise data type of the stored value. Use it to interpret ValueJson. See https://docs.relewise.com/docs/intro/data-types.html for the supported value structures.

valueJson.description: JSON-encoded stored value that consumers must parse according to Type. The text contains only the value payload, not the surrounding Relewise DataValue object. See https://docs.relewise.com/docs/intro/data-types.html for the value structures.

description: One case-sensitive Relewise entity Data Key and its stored value.
